authority_rule: Only the official base commit plus this ordered patch series may produce the Hermes runtime source. Root-level Hermes copies in non_authoritative_tracked_paths are reference-only and are never deployment inputs.

patch_series.description: Official NousResearch/Hermes-Agent PR #85505: durable reset markers, legacy reset-child stabilization, reset-aware listing, and resume-boundary fencing.
Custom cycle-safe, data-dependent traversal shared by compression-tip and parent-lineage resolution; removes the fixed 100-hop failure and adds 218-hop/cycle regressions.

Custom shared session identity projection: numeric gateway resume uses the same activity-ordered listing policy, resume follows compression continuations only, and search deduplicates only compression edges while retaining physical continuation titles; the C4 regression contract explicitly covers compression chains, generic parent edges, and fork ambiguity.

Sanitized incremental overlay derived from the 2026-08-27 16-path live-core backup: Antigravity quota account-usage retrieval, persisted billing-route fallback for /usage, and the focused regression test. It applies after the three existing a31be48030 overlays; two captured trailing blank lines were normalized without changing the intended code paths.
Exact selective overlay of live commit c39995e94d78abd33e21ecb6e47051b644d26640: route synchronous auxiliary completions through the Hermes LLM execution middleware for in-process plugin providers.
Exact selective overlay of live commit a1a38baea746f90d551a278e85bd885c3fa0f117: reset consecutive transport and parse failure counters when resuming a paused goal.

Candidate hardening after independent review: preserve middleware exceptions and prevent duplicate/bypass provider calls; this is intentionally separate from live commit c39995e94d78abd33e21ecb6e47051b644d26640.
